about_short_description.short_description: SchemeFlow is an IT and internet AI tech platform for Automating Government Approvals regarding Construction and Real Estate.

product.name: AI-Powered Transport Planning
product.description: SchemeFlow offers a service that generates draft reports for transport assessments, utilizing AI to automate the process and save time.

product.name: Custom Report Templates
product.description: SchemeFlow can customize reports to match a firm's design, allowing for the use of specific templates and house styles.

product.name: Local Planning Policy Database
product.description: Provides an up-to-date database of local planning policies accessible anytime, supporting the drafting of transport assessments.

product.name: AI Text Editing
product.description: Features a ChatGPT-style AI for technical report writing, enabling users to quickly generate and edit paragraphs of text.

product.name: PDF and Word Export
product.description: Allows users to export draft reports as PDF or Word documents, facilitating easy sharing with clients or project teams.
